export { checkBackendHealth, subscribeBackendStatus, getBackendStatus } from "/src/lib/apiClient.ts";
let authority = "python";
export function getSimulationAuthority() {
  return authority;
}
async function callCommand(cmd, args) {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (!isTestMode() || liveApiRequested())) {
    const result = await callBackend(cmd, args);
    authority = "python";
    return result;
  }
  authority = "test-double";
  const { mockInvoke } = await import("/src/lib/testDouble.stub.ts");
  return mockInvoke(cmd, args);
}
